title: IPRoyal Review (2026)
intro: IPRoyal is evaluated here as a web data / proxy collection platform — IPRoyal sells residential, ISP, datacenter, and mobile proxies with a published residential floor from $1.75/GB. Traffic is marketed as never expiring. startingPriceMonthly $1.75 is that per-GB floor (a 1GB pack equivalent), not a monthly SaaS seat. Same web-data-collection cluster as Bright Data. Bright Data remains the award (7.7); this entity does not outrank it. Budget / SMB proxy peer of ThorData and Decodo (Smartproxy) — thinner enterprise compliance and platform depth than Bright Data / Oxylabs. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose IPRoyal when a published $1.75/GB residential floor is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default.
verdict: Choose IPRoyal when a published $1.75/GB residential floor is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default. Compare Bright Data or Oxylabs for enterprise proxy estates; Decodo (Smartproxy) or ThorData for other budget GB tiles; Zyte or ScraperAPI for managed APIs. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Self-serve GB dashboard is straightforward; product-line choice (residential/ISP/DC/mobile) is the learning curve. Not a lab test.
Residential proxy / web-data-collection — ranked with Bright Data/Smartproxy, not hosting or observability.
Proxy lines cover collection jobs; thinner platform depth than Bright Data, Zyte API, or Apify Actors. Held at 6.
API-first with lighter published SDK/ecosystem depth than Bright Data.
Limited public enterprise compliance packaging versus Bright Data / Oxylabs ISO 27001.
GB packs scale; enterprise SLA story is thinner.
Published $1.75/GB residential floor is the sharpest GB entry in this set. Affiliate economics excluded.
No meaningful AI copilot story — scored low on purpose.
